title: Shared views and explicit tensor copies
description: A quick reference for the tensor-view, layout-transform, and attention-shape terms used here.

terms.definition: A borrowed interpretation of an owner's values with independent shape, stride, and offset metadata.
Changing a contiguous view's shape while preserving its element count and logical order.
Swapping axes and their strides without rearranging the underlying owner's values.
Reordering every tensor axis and its corresponding extent and stride metadata.
A bounded subregion that shares storage while adjusting shape and base offset.
The owner's flat-buffer position from which a view's coordinate mapping begins.
A layout property where logical row-major traversal follows adjacent storage positions without gaps.
Explicitly copying a view's logical values into a new contiguous tensor owner.
Three projected representations used to compare positions and combine information in attention.
One parallel attention computation operating on its own projected feature subspace.
